## Chapter purpose

Study the mathematical structure that explains why statistical estimators behave as they do and when their guarantees apply.

## Topics

::: {.statx-topic-grid}
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>8.1</span>
### Formal probability
Probability spaces, events, random variables, expectations, and variance.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>8.2</span>
### Likelihood
Represent the support that observed data provide for parameter values.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>8.3</span>
### Estimation theory
Maximum likelihood, maximum a posteriori estimation, and estimator properties.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>8.4–8.5</span>
### Generalization and limits
Bias–variance tradeoff, consistency, limiting distributions, and asymptotics.
:::
